The Fourth Derivative of the Expected Information Through a Reparametrization

Source: R/d34e_reparam.R
dexpected_chain4.Rd

Computes the fourth derivative of the expected information in the new coordinates \(\phi\) from the parent's expected information and its first four derivatives, and the map's partial derivatives up to the fifth order.

Usage

dexpected_chain4(Pp, Pn, E, d1, d2, d3, d4, maps, n)

Arguments

Pp, Pn

The parent's parameter names and the new ones.

E, d1, d2, d3, d4

Named lists keyed as hess_names(), dexpected_names(), d2expected_names(), d3expected_names() and d4expected_names() on the parent's parameters.

maps

One keyed table per parent parameter to the order 5.

n

The number of observations, to which every component is recycled.

Value

A named list keyed as d4expected_names() on the new parameters.

Details

The construction is that of dexpected_chain3() with four positions. The assignments of the positions to \(G_{ij}\), \(J_{ia}\) and \(J_{jb}\) number \(3^4\), and the derivative of \(G_{ij}\) along \(S = \{c, d, e, f\}\) is the sum over the fifteen set partitions of \(S\), written by block sizes: $$\partial_{S} G = \sum_k E_{,k}\theta_{k,S} + \sum_{kl} E_{,kl}\Big(\sum_{x \in S} \theta_{k,S\setminus x}\theta_{l,x} + \theta_{k,cd}\theta_{l,ef} + \theta_{k,ce}\theta_{l,df} + \theta_{k,cf}\theta_{l,de}\Big)$$ $$\quad + \sum_{klm} E_{,klm} \sum_{\{x,y\} \subset S} \theta_{k,xy}\,\theta_{l,z}\,\theta_{m,w} + \sum_{klmn} E_{,klmn}\,\theta_{k,c}\theta_{l,d}\theta_{m,e}\theta_{n,f},$$ with \(z, w\) the two positions outside the pair \(\{x, y\}\). The factor \(J_{ia}\) is differentiated up to four times, so the map is read to the fifth order.
